target_customer: Consumers and professionals who want an autonomous AI agent; earlier developers and designers using a vibe coding app builder
problem: Users want an AI that can actually do computer work end to end, such as coding, browsing and producing documents, rather than only chat.
business_model: Consumer and prosumer AI subscription (pricing not found)
product_category: AI agent with a computer, previously AI app builder (Orchids)

founders.name: Kevin Lu
education: University of Pennsylvania, CS and Math
founders.background_notes: Worked on gen AI at AWS and did research at Stanford HAI per YC page.

founders.name: Bach Tran
founders.background_notes: Engineering at Addepar. YC page says Tran builds Orchids while Lu builds Bud.

exit.reason: Acqui-hire of the team; Orchids and Bud products shut down by 2026-07-18

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrating models with sandboxed computers, browser control and code execution is demanding but built on third party frontier models.

defensibility.rationale: Depended on third party models and faced fast moving, well funded app builders and agents; products were easy to substitute.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The team was acqui-hired by Figma in July 2026 and both products were shut down.

market_need_then: AI coding and agent tools saw strong adoption in 2025; the founders' own claims of traction were not independently verified.

branding.domain_note: Uses bud.app, a short .app domain; the earlier product Orchids ran on a separate name.

identity.voice_and_tone: Personal assistant framing, reachable by text or Telegram

rebrands.why: Moved from vibe coding to a general agent; exact date and reason not stated in sources found

brand_strength.rationale: No evidence of brand driven awareness; two product names split attention and both shut down.

pivots.from: Orchids, a vibe coding app builder
pivots.to: Bud, an agent with a computer
pivots.why: Not stated; coverage says it began as vibe coding then became an agent platform

outcome_analysis: The team built Orchids as a vibe coding builder in the YC W25 batch, then repositioned to Bud as a general computer using agent. In July 2026 Figma acqui-hired the team and both products closed by 18 July, with undisclosed terms. That is a soft landing without a standalone product outcome, in a segment crowded by Lovable, Bolt, Replit and v0.
notes: Company site bud.app returned HTTP 503 on fetch. Seed estimates conflict across aggregators ($0.5M to $2.6M; investors named include YC, BoxGroup, Susa Ventures, Browder) and no primary source was found, so none recorded as a round. Competitor list left empty: only undated or 2026 vendor pages were found, and competitors named there (Lovable, Bolt, Replit, v0) have no early 2025 dated source. No primary Figma announcement found.
